mentions.claim_text: He says it is to stop the drug and sex trafficking because of the money involved, that he sees the other man hiding in a bunker in a mountain, and adds that if he is missing it it could be a metaphor and he does not know.
mentions.quote: if I'm missing it it could be metaphor. I don't even know
mentions.falsify_match: The leader is found to have gone underground.
mentions.falsify_miss: He is not. He offers the metaphor reading himself before anyone else can.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is nowhere near over, that they are about to see things they did not want to see, and that young people will be involved and will retaliate for what happened to the removed Venezuelan leader, rising up and causing turmoil.
mentions.quote: They're going to retaliate for what happened to Maduro
mentions.falsify_match: Youth unrest in Venezuela following the removal.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says a major army is needed to do all this and to protect their people, and that he sees their own drones flying around and their military stationed.
mentions.quote: we need a major army going if we're going to do all this
mentions.falsify_match: A large American deployment with drone cover.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks the Lord for all that is shown on the programme and then speaks in tongues without interpretation.
mentions.quote: We couldn't do this without you, of course, Lord
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; no content given.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are in a time like he has never seen before, that he has such a caution for America right now, and prays over Hawaii, Honolulu, the military bases there and the families.
mentions.quote: I have such a caution for America right now
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on Hawaii or its bases.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. A caution with nothing named cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He says it takes only a little for him to move to another place, that he is looking into Ukraine and Russia again, and that he sees an uprising and an upticking in the war because they are very annoyed about Venezuela.
mentions.quote: I see an uprising and upticking in war
mentions.falsify_match: Escalation in Ukraine tied to the Venezuela operation.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says the men around him in the mountain were African-American men and that he is facing towards America, then points to a spot on a map his co-host is showing and asks whether there is a mountain there.
mentions.quote: those men right there, African-American men, were all around him
mentions.falsify_match: A bunker at the identified location.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is found. The location is being pinned against a map pulled up on air rather than named in advance.

mentions.claim_text: He says the European Union stood very strong against the American president telling him they would not allow it, and that he saw the place divided in half, with the elders not wanting to join the United States and the young people wanting to.
mentions.quote: I saw it divided by fit half
mentions.falsify_match: A Greenland vote splitting along generational lines.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such vote occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is about minerals for batteries and whatever else is in the dirt, and that he saw big dump trucks going down and getting the minerals, and that he saw fish.
mentions.quote: I saw big dump trucks
mentions.falsify_match: Mineral extraction begins at scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Critical minerals are the openly stated reason for the interest, so this is not new information.

mentions.claim_text: He says they would make it like America, sharing what they have as they would anywhere else, and jokes with his co-host about the fast food chains arriving.
mentions.quote: we'll share what we have
mentions.falsify_match: American commercial integration follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He marks this as his own guess, saying I do not know.

mentions.claim_text: He asks how much they would be offered for it to be agreed, says twenty five thousand dollars per citizen, notes that reports say one hundred thousand, and says what he saw in the real agreement was over twenty five thousand.
mentions.quote: I saw what came to the real agreement was over 25,000
mentions.falsify_match: A per-citizen offer in that range.
mentions.falsify_miss: No offer is made, or it lands at the reported hundred thousand. He deliberately sets his number against the reported one, which makes it scoreable either way.

mentions.claim_text: He says they all know what is coming and were warned to pray about it, then turns to what he keeps being warned about concerning Cuba and puts the count at eighty times.
mentions.quote: He's warned us how many times? 80 times about Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: The archive contains roughly that many Cuba warnings.
mentions.falsify_miss: It contains far fewer. A count of his own record is checkable against the record itself.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in Seattle another major attack is coming, that he saw it all over the place and that the Lord showed him, then turns to a major earthquake there and Yellowstone going off.
mentions.quote: What I see in Seattle, another major attack's coming
mentions.falsify_match: An attack in Seattle.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says they continue to see a major uprising in Iran and must pray for their safety, and that as they prayed into it the Lord showed a major revival coming to Iran that would be a window of opportunity.
mentions.quote: a major revival coming to Iran and it would be a window of opportunity
mentions.falsify_match: A documented religious movement in Iran.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges.

mentions.claim_text: He says a new leader will be just like the removed one because that is how they think, that it was not just about getting rid of him but about levels of government, and that the corruption and witchcraft went layer after layer like an onion.
mentions.quote: It was layers like an onion full of corruption
mentions.falsify_match: A successor government of the same character.
mentions.falsify_miss: A reforming one takes over.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is about the oil and a great place of provision, asks whether to say it out loud, and says he sees one of the cryptocurrencies hitting five dollars really quickly, that it will make people very happy and that it will be five dollars quickly.
mentions.quote: I see one of the cryptos hitting $5 really quickly
mentions.falsify_match: A cryptocurrency he has named elsewhere reaches five dollars soon after.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. He does not name the coin here either.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking partly in tongues he says he sees Japan again and the woman, mentions the blade of what they are about to see, says the same for South Korea, and that Japan is at the forefront.
mentions.quote: But Japan is forefron
mentions.falsify_match: Japan moves ahead of South Korea on the matter in question.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. What the two are at the forefront of is not stated here.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees buildings with glass fronts, that these are banks in Manhattan, works out the name aloud and settles on a named bank, and asks what it is about to do.
mentions.quote: What is Bank of America about to do?
mentions.falsify_match: A major move by the named bank.
mentions.falsify_miss: None follows. He asks the question rather than answering it.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are going to sign it, that he sees a second named bank coming right behind it almost touching, and a third out on a wagon.
mentions.quote: They're going to sign. I see Chase coming right behind it
mentions.falsify_match: The named banks sign on in that order.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees white water rapids, that it is going to be like white water rapids, very bumpy and very turbulent all around the two named banks.
mentions.quote: It's going to be like white water rapids. Very bumpy
mentions.falsify_match: A period of visible instability at the named banks.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Bumpy and turbulent are not scoreable without a measure.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the name of a large asset manager with darkness swelling around it, connected to England, and names the king, Canada, Toronto, the Canadian prime minister and the French president around it.
mentions.quote: I see the word BlackRock. And I see darkness swelling around them
mentions.falsify_match: A documented link between the firm and those figures.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. Darkness is not a claim that can fail.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is on the Mediterranean seeing Israel and a great wealth coming to Israel, and Gaza being developed with hotels.
mentions.quote: I see a great wealth coming to Israel
mentions.falsify_match: Large-scale development capital into Gaza.
mentions.falsify_miss: None arrives.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is big money about to develop Gaza rather than poverty, that it looks like something the American president would have his hand in, and that he sees resorts and golf courses.
mentions.quote: This is big money that's about to develop the Gaza
mentions.falsify_match: Resort development in Gaza with American involvement.
mentions.falsify_miss: None proceeds.

mentions.claim_text: He works out the Saudi crown prince's name with his son, says it is him standing close, and that there are others standing there including one he finds dominant and has never seen before.
mentions.quote: It's him. He's standing up here close
mentions.falsify_match: An unfamiliar figure emerges alongside the crown prince.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does.

mentions.claim_text: He says of Gaza and the war torn area that they are building the third temple, and that he sees oil deals, crude oil in a black barrel and old style oil derricks.
mentions.quote: This is they're building the third temple
mentions.falsify_match: Third temple construction begins.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have their hand in developing Gaza and that he sees shopping malls, restaurants and a tourist industry, and that the Lord just said it is coming.
mentions.quote: The Lord just said it's coming
mentions.falsify_match: Commercial development of Gaza on that pattern.
mentions.falsify_miss: None proceeds.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether what he is being shown is years or months away, then says he sees a golf course flag at the ninth hole with the president's name on it reading Trump golf course Gaza, and describes it as white looking.
mentions.quote: Is this years? Is this months?
mentions.falsify_match: A course of that name is built.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. He asks the timing question and does not get an answer, so no window attaches.

mentions.claim_text: He says a named American official comes in cracking a whip, telling them they are changing these things and will revalue their money and do what they are told, and calls it a strong arm.
mentions.quote: revalue their money you're going to do what we tell you to do
mentions.falsify_match: An American-forced currency revaluation.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says there was a stream in front of them of white water rapids by the banks, that he saw the major banks and that the large asset manager was standing by itself for Europe.
mentions.quote: I saw BlackRock was standing by itself for Europe
mentions.falsify_match: The firm takes a distinct European role.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw England, the royals and the Canadian prime minister all trying to be part of the asset manager somehow, and a digital age and a digital frontier.
mentions.quote: I saw them all trying to be a part of BlackRock somehow
mentions.falsify_match: Those figures take positions connected to the firm.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. Somehow is doing the work here.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when he saw the Saudi crown prince coming along, the prince began helping build the temple and bringing his people forward, and that money then flowed with men in aviator glasses who looked like businessmen.
mentions.quote: he started helping build that temple
mentions.falsify_match: Saudi money behind temple construction.
mentions.falsify_miss: None appears.

mentions.claim_text: He welcomes the audience, remarks that the viewer count went up fast because they had notifications on, and says they will go over what the Lord showed them the night before.
mentions.quote: That number shot up fast
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; an opening.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no content.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not think there was ever a time the Lord brought something up eighty times, that he did not know and was shocked himself, and then turns to reviewing what they saw in the previous video.
mentions.quote: I don't think he's ever brought up something 80 times
mentions.falsify_match: The archive bears out the count.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He volunteers his own surprise at the number, which suggests it was counted rather than felt.

mentions.claim_text: He says the wave was shallow but as it reached the ground it laid a thin layer of gold on the ground of the United States, and that the Lord told him to fill his pockets.
mentions.quote: it brought a thin layer of gold
mentions.falsify_match: A broad but shallow financial gain across the country.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Shallow and thin are not scoreable without a measure.

mentions.claim_text: He says fountains of wealth come from Zion and that the wealth is coming from Zion, adding that he does not want to misquote but believes that is what was said, then turns to the Russian president moving an oil tanker out of Venezuela.
mentions.quote: I don't want to misquote him, but that's what I believe he said
mentions.falsify_match: Wealth traced to Israel in the way he means.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. He marks the quotation itself as uncertain, which is unusual.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls seeing during the current presidency what would try to be a major draft for the United States because of a great war breaking out in Europe, and compares the scene to the film Saving Private Ryan.
mentions.quote: what would try to be a major draft for the United States
mentions.falsify_match: American conscription during this term.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is called. Try to be leaves room for a draft that is proposed and fails.

mentions.claim_text: He says forces came out of the woodwork with alliances from the Middle East surrounding it and a major war broke out, and that he saw Americans in a single file line.
mentions.quote: they had alliances coming from the Middle East to surround this
mentions.falsify_match: A Middle Eastern coalition entering a European war.
mentions.falsify_miss: None forms.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was told that a level of glory is coming but a level of purification with it because to whom much is given much is required, and that on that day he saw great corruption coming out of California.
mentions.quote: I saw that day great corruption coming out of California
mentions.falsify_match: A major Californian corruption case.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges.

mentions.claim_text: He returns to the earthquake he saw on the Californian coastline running from San Francisco up to the British Columbia area, mentioning that his co-host looks things up in the search engine for them.
mentions.quote: the earthquake that I saw on the uh California coastline
mentions.falsify_match: A major quake along that stretch.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the same thing concerning the coastline of Italy, that they keep seeing mega quakes and mega volcanic eruptions and have not seen it in the natural as they have in the spirit, that maybe prayer is stopping it, and that the Ring of Fire is very active with Japan splitting.
mentions.quote: So maybe that's prayer stopping it. I don't know
mentions.falsify_match: A major event on the Italian coast.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs, which he pre-emptively reads as prayer stopping it. The structure means neither outcome counts against him.

mentions.claim_text: He says they were trying to sponge and wipe the evidence out for the corruption brought out by a young man in Minnesota, that other states know about it, and that the sheriffs are coming.
mentions.quote: they were trying to wipe the evidence out for all the corruption
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence destruction in the Minnesota case is documented.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw arrows coming out of corruption into Ukraine with money laundering, and cites a figure of one and a half trillion dollars of fraud raised by a named businessman.
mentions.quote: I saw arrows coming out of corruption into Ukraine with money laundering
mentions.falsify_match: Documented laundering on that route.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. The trillion and a half figure is sourced to someone else rather than seen.

mentions.claim_text: He says it hit a bank and he saw a vault representing government money, with little arrows coming out of it going to secret accounts throughout Europe, some in Africa and some in the Middle East.
mentions.quote: all these little arrows started coming out of it and going to secret accounts
mentions.falsify_match: Government funds traced to accounts on those continents.
mentions.falsify_miss: None are.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw labs for corruption, one of them fifteen million dollars, remarks that he says a lot, and says he saw a hundred million dollars in cash connected to a politician.
mentions.quote: I saw labs for corruption and there was one was 15 million dollars
mentions.falsify_match: Sums of that order surface in the case.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them the politician was the Ukrainian president, that he saw a hundred million dollars in hundred dollar bills, and all this corruption of money.
mentions.quote: I told you all it was Zelenskyy
mentions.falsify_match: A hundred million dollars in cash tied to the named man.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. Naming the person makes this scoreable rather than open-ended.

mentions.claim_text: He calls certain coins to go over five dollars in prayer, says they call that five dollars to come forth per coin, that it is turning around and that it will provide overflow for the body of Christ.
mentions.quote: We call that $5 to come forth in Jesus' name per coin
mentions.falsify_match: A named coin reaches five dollars.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. Certain ones is never resolved to a ticker.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know when it will happen but saw silver going over one hundred and seventy dollars an ounce, that he told everybody this in past videos, and calls that price forth in prayer.
mentions.quote: I saw silver going a over $170 an ounce
mentions.falsify_match: Silver trades above one hundred and seventy dollars an ounce.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He says outright that he does not know when, so the number carries no window.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks the Lord for where it already is and prays that it double and then triple, and notes with his co-host that it has gone down today.
mentions.quote: I thank you that you double it. Then you triple it
mentions.falsify_match: The price doubles then triples.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He says he knows there are pullbacks and dips and that they do not move by that but keep watching, and recalls that when it was at twelve dollars an ounce the number would have seemed impossible.
mentions.quote: I know there's pullbacks, there's dips
mentions.falsify_match: The staged path he describes plays out.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Declaring dips irrelevant in advance means no fall can count against the call.

mentions.claim_text: He says gold was about fourteen or fifteen hundred dollars an ounce, gives the current price as four thousand four hundred and thirty eight, and says the Lord told them it would go to ten thousand one day and that he has prayed over it since.
mentions.quote: It's at $4,438 an ounce
mentions.falsify_match: Gold clears ten thousand dollars an ounce.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The current price he gives is checkable against the market record for 8 January 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says this will be a time of great blessing but also disappointing for many because they have a vision of grandeur of hundreds of millions, and that he saw numbers people were very disappointed about.
mentions.quote: it will also be disappointing for a lot of you
mentions.falsify_match: The transfer arrives at the smaller scale he describes.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not arrive at all. Worth recording as a downward revision of his own earlier teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He says they cannot get discouraged about a million dollars, and that many of them have the grand idea of believing for twenty or thirty million that would change generations.
mentions.quote: you can't get discouraged about a million dollars
mentions.falsify_match: Sums of that order reach the audience.
mentions.falsify_miss: None do.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said the seeds sowed in the past will come to harvest at last, that this is not about the bad seeds the wicked have sown, that he is a god of the harvest and will bring in a financial harvest beyond anything they can imagine.
mentions.quote: the seeds that you've sowed in the past will come to harvest at last
mentions.falsify_match: A transfer on the scale described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He warns them not to spend money deposited in their account by mistake, citing a woman who did and is now in prison, and says not to be foolish about it.
mentions.quote: she spent it all and she's in prison now. So, don't be dumb
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a caution attached to the teaching.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss, though a caveat against reading windfalls as the promised transfer is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says that if he does not see it, it is not there and it is fake, that he is grateful he can pass on what he is shown, and that he is only telling them what he saw driving around that day, then asks whether there is anything else and says that if not he is at peace.
mentions.quote: If I don't see it, it ain't there
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a rule about his own practice.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss, though it is a stated refusal to fill gaps, and he says outright that if nothing comes he is at peace.
